question: The game has full legislature rules for only nine states (Alaska, Illinois, Kentucky, Maryland, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, Nevada, Ohio). For each of the other 41 states, D.C. and the five inhabited territories (Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, American Samoa and the Northern Mariana Islands), answered as one set: the chambers and their seat counts; term lengths and whether terms are staggered; when regular sessions meet and for how long, and who can call a special session; quorum; the vote needed to pass a bill, to override a veto, to pass a budget or tax bill, and to propose a constitutional amendment; how a bill moves (introduction, committee referral, readings, floor, the other chamber, conference, presentment to the executive); whether bills carry over between sessions; and how a vacancy is filled. Cite the constitutional, statutory or rule provision and mark anything not found as UNKNOWN.
